body.message:
Good morning Catarina,

Thank you for your message and for explaining the situation. We completely understand, and we appreciate your honesty as well as your excellent payment history.

Please note that our monthly bookings are calculated based on 30-night stays rather than calendar months. This is why the payment due date changes with each monthly extension.

That's perfectly fine. You may proceed with the AED 5,000 payment today as mentioned, and you can settle the remaining balance by Monday, as advised. I will share the updated payment link with you shortly.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. We truly appreciate it, and we wish you all the best with your annual lease renewal.
